Author: A. S. Gadkari
Bench: A. S. Gadkari
dtg 63-wp5478.2021.doc
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction
 Writ Petition No. 5478 Of 2021
Naushad Idris Khan ... Petitioner
 V/s.
The State of Maharashtra & Ors. ... Respondents
 _______________________________________
Mr. Mateen Shaikh for Petitioner.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Mr. Vinod Chate, App for Respondent-State.

Mr. Dattatraya Sonwalkar, Api, Uttan Sagari Police Station, present.
 _______________________________________
 Coram : A. S. Gadkari And
 Ranjitsinha Raja Bhonsale, Jj.
Date : 16th September 2025.

P.C. :
1) In the case in hand, investigation of a crime under Section 328 read with 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Sections 41 and 88 of the Food Safety and Standards Act,
2006, is being conducted for last more than four and half years.
This is not only shocking but also unconscionable.
Numerous redundant and superfluous excuses are advanced across the bar in justifying non completion of investigation of such a minor nature, for last more than four and half years.
We do not want to burden this Order by recording all such superfluous submissions made across the bar.

2) In view of the above, we deemed it appropriate to bring the said fact to the notice of the Commissioner of Police, Mira-Bhayandar Vasai-Virar dtg 63-wp5478.2021.doc Police Commissionerate and direct him to file his detailed reply to the Petition,
within a period of three weeks from today.
